answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can gain reputation or influence. Independent validators check that the bond is tied to a distinct accountable party and slash it when evidence shows duplicate identities coordinating abuse. This creates a haven for honest entrants without relying on account age: an attacker can still make identities, but each ties up capital and risks forfeiture. A prism of validators reduces collusion, though cannot eliminate it; the nadir is trusting their checks.
